name: Workspace Collation Settings for Warehouse & SQL Analytics Endpoint in Microsoft Fabric
description: Workspace-level collation settings enable organizations to standardize collation across all **Warehouses** and **SQL Endpoints** within a Microsoft Fabric workspace, ensuring seamless integration and predictable behavior.New and Existing Workspaces defaults to **Case Sensitive (CS)** collation, aligning with current default settings and existing artifacts in older workspaces retain their original collation (often CS) to avoid disruptions.**Admins, Members, and Contributors**: Can modify workspace collation settings at any time via the workspace settings panel. Changes apply only to new artifacts and  **Viewers** can view collation settings but cannot edit them.

result.nameEs: Intercalación del workspace para Warehouse y SQL analytics endpoint en Microsoft Fabric
